title: Baltic Freight 3: A bad day
lead: Not every day is easy. A customer calls with a complaint, you help a truck at the border and you plan a shift with the warehouse team.
how: You work at Baltic Freight, a logistics company. Choose what you say.
Green ✓ is right. Red ✕ is not this one. You can try again and you will see what to say. Right the first time? You get a star ★.
Tap an underlined word to see what it means.

decisions.q: My boxes arrived damaged! I want to make a complaint.
good: I'm very sorry. Can you tell me what happened?

decisions.q: Whose fault is it? Is it the driver?
good: I don't know yet. We are looking for the reason.
We'll send you new boxes tomorrow, and we will pay for the damage.

decisions.q: Can you write the rule for the drivers?
good: Yes. "Drivers must tie the boxes with two belts."
wrong: No, I am not a driver.

good: Cotton shirts, five hundred pieces. The invoice is here.

decisions.q: There is a mistake. The date is wrong.
good: I'm sorry. Can we correct it now?

decisions.q: You must pay duty. It is two hundred euros.
good: Okay. Can I pay by card?
I'll take the morning shift. I like to start early.

decisions.q: What do we tell the new workers first?
good: First the safety rules. Then the machines.
